title: Mongo data editor
description: Browse and edit documents in a collection.

workspace.description: Select a workspace to edit data.

workspace.denied: This organization has no workspaces yet. Ask an organization or workspace owner or administrator to create the first one.

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDescription: Insert the first document with the form below.

confirm.instruction: The button unlocks when the text matches exactly.

keys.previewCount: Preview with this key: {count, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}.

json.selectHint: Select a value to copy it
